[[File:Charge Air Orb icon (mobile).png|left|class=pageimage]]
'''Charge Air Orb''' is a spell which can be cast on the [[Air Obelisk]] above [[Edgeville Dungeon]], turning an [[unpowered orb]] into an [[air orb]]. It requires 66 Magic to cast, at which point it will [[autocast]] every 3.6 seconds. Players can speed up this time by casting it manually for each orb; it is possible to gain up to 40,000 [[Magic]] experience per hour using the spell in this way.

Using an air orb on a [[battlestaff]] makes an [[air battlestaff]], requiring 66 [[Crafting]] and granting 137.5 Crafting experience. Charging an [[air orb]] is a hard task for the [[Wilderness Diary Hard|Wilderness Diary]].

=== Wilderness location ===
The Air Obelisk is located above the Edgeville Dungeon, and requires going into level 7 [[Wilderness]] to access. Players may be attacked by other players within 7 combat levels of them; as such, some players create pures to attack low-level accounts casting the spell.
